description:
Implements a high-effort ZAPBench E06 fit_predict procedure using the same architecture and transformations as the analytic NLinear reference. The model fits a separate dense temporal mapping (64→32 frames) over all neuron/window pairs, using ridge regression (alpha=1), with a bias term fitted without penalty. The model subtracts the last observed context frame from both input and target during fitting/prediction and restores it to output after mapping. Only training data is used for parameter fitting; no test leakage or tuning. Training and test/test-holdout samples are handled generically. Deterministic seed is set for internal repeatability. Returns a numpy array of predictions (float64, shape (len(test_x),32,256)). Adheres to requirements: no conditions, groups or non-numeric features; all test data strictly out-of-sample; no test-window joining or pooled test fitting; no nonstandard packages or pretrained networks; fit+predict in a single process/thread with bounded memory.

Note: No fit/execution/repair is performed here, as per the prompt. The explicit numpy-based closed-form (ridge) regression is pooled over all neurons, stacking all training windows/neurons for efficient full-batch fit.
